headline: Problem reports can now show, not just tell
highlights: The problem-report dialog can now attach screenshots — up to three images, downscaled before they travel, for the problems words can't carry: a broken layout, a wrong colour, a control out of place.

\u{2318}Q pauses on one plain question when quitting would cost something. A session that isn't saved to a package offers Save and Quit / Quit Anyway / Cancel — Save and Quit writes the same .klsession package as \u{21E7}\u{2318}S — and a build, export, package save or import still mid-flight asks before being abandoned. A quit with nothing to lose stays instant.
